name: What options are available for improving window insulation?

mainEntity.name: What options are available for improving window insulation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several options exist to improve window insulation without full replacement. These include adding weatherstripping or caulk to seal air leaks, installing storm windows for an extra layer of glass, or applying low-emissivity (low-e) films that reflect heat. For more significant upgrades, consider replacing single-pane windows with double or triple-pane units, or installing insulated blinds and curtains. The best choice depends on your current windows and desired performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options range from sealing leaks and adding storm windows or low-e films to full window replacement or insulated coverings.
